The '''Death's Claw''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Known for robbing anything that talked and shooting anything that didn't. While exploring Taris, they acquired relics that once belonged to the [[Jedi Covenant]].<ref name="TOR" />
